en: A vintage postcard displaying a colorized image of a broad street lined with ornate stone buildings, with street lamps, pedestrians, and signage in Swedish, including 'HOTEL KNAUST' and 'H.A. PERSSON'. The lower part of the image contains printed text in Swedish: 'STORGATAN I SUNDSVALL', and handwritten cursive writing in black ink surrounds the image edges. The reverse side includes postal instructions in multiple languages, a recipient address, and more handwritten text.
